answer: A new agent enters a low-weight haven where its refundable bond unlocks only as independent peers attest to genuine, varied work. Trust accrues slowly, like a violet opening petal by petal, never bought in bulk. A clone fleet betrays itself as a tight delta of correlated timing and shared funding, and each flagged bond is slashed. Because every fake identity must post its own stake and wait out its own vesting window, the sybil cost scales linearly with the number of fakes rather than collapsing to near zero.
